text: A hard day is information, not a verdict.
Fear is a loud passenger; you are still the one driving.
The setback did not erase the work; it only changed the next step.
Not every thought deserves a microphone in my head.
You are not behind. You are just taking the next step differently.
My first thought is a draft, not the final version of this day.
The mountain does not move for you, but the path changes with each step you take.
A wrong turn is still a turn. I can correct the direction without shaming myself.
Fear can sit beside me without holding the pen. I still write the next line.
